asked.item: Charged 2,000 credits on every run of the POST /v2/credits call
Running it several times in a test loop

verdict.reason: The Credits pages say Buy Credits only creates a Stripe Checkout link and charges nothing until payment is completed in a browser.

steps.text: Calling Buy Credits (POST /v2/credits) does not charge anything.
It returns a Stripe Checkout link (checkoutUrl), and the account owner completes payment by opening that link in a browser.
If your loop runs this call often, a 429 error means the rate limit was exceeded (10 requests per hour).
